title: docs(adr): ADR-0011 says the identity census covers twelve identity objects; the tree has thirteen since the 2026-11-07 SCIM amendment
body:
domain:skills#3 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jULfPnqQFGcZUtKDFH

Filing gate: (b) a follow-up a review names. Contract review 6724527824 on PR #31616 (card #31452), ④ nit, outside that PR's diff. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

ADR-0011 的身份动作评估段说评估覆盖了 `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/` 里「十二个」身份对象。2026-11-07 的修订把 `sys_scim_connection_credential` 的两个动作也收进了评估，现在带动作的身份对象是 13 个。这句话读起来像现在的清点，其实停在了修订之前。只改一个词，不涉及任何评估。

## What

- `docs/adr/0011-actions-as-ai-tools.md` L317-318 (on `main` 133f75ae): "The named actions on the twelve identity objects in `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/` were assessed once, as one set".
- Measured by the review on the live tree: 13 action-bearing objects under that directory, the 13th being `sys_scim_connection_credential`, whose two actions came with the 2026-11-07 amendment (the ADR's own census paragraph, L375-376).

## Ask

- Either say thirteen and note the amendment, or make the sentence explicitly historical ("twelve at the 2026-10-30 assessment"). Pick by reading the paragraph whole. Tier H (`docs/adr/**`).

## Not in scope

- Assessing `sys_user.list_platform_admins` or `sys_sso_provider.edit_sso_sign_in_options` (a maintainer ruling).

Related: #31452, PR #31616.
